143: 	 * @param width			The width of the thumbnail to produce.
144: 	 * @param height		The height of the thumbnails to produce.
145: 	 * @param aspectRatio	Whether or not to maintain the aspect ratio in the
146: 	 * 						thumbnail the same as the original image.
147: 	 * 						<p>
148: 	 * 						If {@code true} is specified, then the
149: 	 * 						thumbnail image will have the same aspect ratio
150: 	 * 						as the original image.
151: 	 * @param fit			Whether or not to fit the thumbnail within the
152: 	 * 						specified dimensions.
153: 	 * 						<p>
154: 	 * 						If {@code true} is specified, then the thumbnail
155: 	 * 						will be sized to fit within the specified
156: 	 * 						{@code width} and {@code height}.
157: 	 */
158: 	public FixedSizeThumbnailMaker(int width, int height, boolean aspectRatio, boolean fit) {
159: 		this();
160: 		size(width, height);
161: 		keepAspectRatio(aspectRatio);
162: 		fitWithinDimensions(fit);
163: 	}
164: 	
165: 	/**
166: 	 * Sets the size of the thumbnail to produce.
167: 	 * 
168: 	 * @param width				The width of the thumbnail to produce.
169: 	 * @param height			The height of the thumbnails to produce.
170: 	 * @return					A reference to this object.
171: 	 * @throws IllegalStateException	If the size has already
172: 	 * 									been previously set, or if the
173: 	 * 									{@code width} or {@code height} is less
174: 	 * 									than or equal to zero.
175: 	 */
176: 	public FixedSizeThumbnailMaker size(int width, int height) {
177: 		if (ready.isSet(PARAM_SIZE)) {
178: 			throw new IllegalStateException(
179: 					"The size has already been set."
180: 			);
181: 		}
182: 		
183: 		if (width <= 0) {
184: 			throw new IllegalArgumentException(
185: 					"Width must be greater than zero."
186: 			);
187: 		}
188: 		if (height <= 0) {
189: 			throw new IllegalArgumentException(
190: 					"Height must be greater than zero."
191: 			);
192: 		}
193: 		
194: 		this.width = width;
195: 		this.height = height;
196: 
197: 		ready.set(PARAM_SIZE);
198: 		return this;
199: 	}
200: 	
201: 	/**
202: 	 * Sets whether or not the thumbnail is to maintain the aspect ratio of
203: 	 * the original image.
204: 	 * 
205: 	 * @param keep			Whether or not to maintain the aspect ratio in the
206: 	 * 						thumbnail the same as the original image.
207: 	 * 						<p>
208: 	 * 						If {@code true} is specified, then the
209: 	 * 						thumbnail image will have the same aspect ratio
210: 	 * 						as the original image.
211:  	 * @return				A reference to this object.
212: 	 * @throws IllegalStateException	If whether to keep the aspect ratio has
213: 	 * 									already	been previously set.
214: 	 */
215: 	public FixedSizeThumbnailMaker keepAspectRatio(boolean keep) {
216: 		if (ready.isSet(PARAM_KEEP_RATIO)) {
217: 			throw new IllegalStateException(
218: 					"Whether to keep the aspect ratio has already been set."
219: 			);
220: 		}
221: 		this.keepRatio = keep;
222: 
223: 		ready.set(PARAM_KEEP_RATIO);
224: 		return this;
225: 	}
226: 	
227: 	/**
228: 	 * Sets whether or not the thumbnail should fit within the specified
229: 	 * dimensions.
230: 	 * <p>
231: 	 * When the dimensions of a thumbnail will exceed the specified dimensions,
232: 	 * with the aspect ratio of the original being preserved, then if this
233: 	 * method was called with {@code false}, then the resulting thumbnail will
234: 	 * have the larger dimension align with the specified dimension, and the
235: 	 * other will exceed the given dimension.
236: 	 * <p>
237: 	 * When {@link #keepAspectRatio(boolean)} is {@code false}, then calling
238: 	 * this method with {@code true} or {@code false} makes no difference, as
239: 	 * the thumbnail dimensions will be exactly the given dimensions.
240: 	 * 
241: 	 * @param fit			Whether or not to maintain the aspect ratio in the
242: 	 * 						thumbnail the same as the original image.
243: 	 * 						<p>
244: 	 * 						If {@code true} is specified, then the
245: 	 * 						thumbnail image will have the same aspect ratio
246: 	 * 						as the original image.
247: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
248: 	 * @throws IllegalStateException	If whether to keep the aspect ratio has
249: 	 * 									already	been previously set.
250: 	 * @since 0.4.0
251: 	 */
252: 	public FixedSizeThumbnailMaker fitWithinDimensions(boolean fit) {
253: 		if (ready.isSet(PARAM_FIT_WITHIN)) {
254: 			throw new IllegalStateException(
255: 					"Whether to fit within dimensions has already been set."
256: 			);
257: 		}
258: 		this.fitWithinDimensions = fit;
259: 		
260: 		ready.set(PARAM_FIT_WITHIN);
261: 		return this;
262: 	}
263: 	
264: 	@Override
265: 	public BufferedImage make(BufferedImage img) {
266: 		int targetWidth = this.width;
267: 		int targetHeight = this.height;
268: 
269: 		if (keepRatio) {
270: 			int sourceWidth = img.getWidth();
271: 			int sourceHeight = img.getHeight();
272: 			
273: 			double sourceRatio = (double)sourceWidth / (double)sourceHeight;
274: 			double targetRatio = (double)targetWidth / (double)targetHeight;
275: 			
276: 			/*
277: 			 * If the ratios are not the same, then the appropriate
278: 			 * width and height must be picked.
279: 			 */
280: 			if (Double.compare(sourceRatio, targetRatio) != 0) {
281: 				if (fitWithinDimensions) {
282: 					if (sourceRatio > targetRatio) {
283: 						targetWidth = width;
284: 						targetHeight = (int)Math.round(targetWidth / sourceRatio);
285: 					} else {
286: 						targetWidth = (int)Math.round(targetHeight * sourceRatio);
287: 						targetHeight = height;
288: 					}
289: 				} else {
290: 					if (sourceRatio > targetRatio) {
291: 						targetWidth = (int)Math.round(targetHeight * sourceRatio);
292: 						targetHeight = height;
293: 					} else {
294: 						targetWidth = width;
295: 						targetHeight = (int)Math.round(targetWidth / sourceRatio);
296: 					}
297: 				}
298: 			}
